scope: Programme hold on automated acquisition, extraction, mining and reprocessing of JAMA Network article content, including supplements, corrections, cached copies and copies on other hosts.
evidence: Operator instruction dated 5 November 2026 documenting the publisher restriction and the commitment already sent on 4 November. Original correspondence remains private; no article content is needed to enforce this hold.
release: Reviewed code and policy change supported by documented clarification or permission. A licence flag or a change of host alone cannot release this programme hold.
default: HOLD until source identity, operation-specific permission, applicable restrictions and evidence are verified and recorded
manual_reading: This gate governs automated processing. It makes no determination prohibiting ordinary scholarly reading.
ethics: Ethics review is a separate governance question; this policy makes no determination about whether review is required.
